response.sql: WITH transaction_averages AS (SELECT tr.transreg AS transaction_reference, tr.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix, AVG(sf.shortintrt) AS avg_short_interest, AVG(sf.optvolrt) AS avg_option_volume_ratio FROM transactionrecord AS tr JOIN sentimentandfundamentals AS sf ON sf.transref = tr.transreg GROUP BY tr.transreg, tr.ordertypedist), comparisons AS (SELECT transaction_reference, order_type_mix, avg_short_interest, avg_option_volume_ratio, AVG(avg_short_interest) OVER (PARTITION BY order_type_mix) AS order_type_avg_short_interest FROM transaction_averages) SELECT transaction_reference, order_type_mix, avg_short_interest, avg_option_volume_ratio, avg_short_interest / NULLIF(order_type_avg_short_interest, 0) AS short_interest_ratio FROM comparisons ORDER BY short_interest_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
